description: Return scored posts from Reddit, Hacker News and the open web where someone is asking for a product like the project's - highest intent score (1-100) first, with the matched query and the reasons for the score. Reads signals found by earlier scans; pass scan: true to search live sources first. Costs 1 credit.

include_muted.description: Include posts from authors and subreddits the workspace has muted. Default false, matching the dashboard.

limit.description: Maximum signals to return, 1-100, highest score first. With scan: true it also caps results fetched per search query.

min_intent_score.description: Lowest intent score to return, 1-100. 90+ is asking for exactly this now, 75-89 is comparing options, 60-74 is related; below 60 is mostly noise.

platforms.description: Sources to include. "web" is pages found through search indexes. "twitter" is accepted but not scanned yet, so it returns nothing.

project_id.description: Project to search. Get ids from list_projects.

scan.description: Refresh from live sources before returning. Slower, and spends one of the workspace's daily scans (free plan: one a day across all projects) on top of the call's credit. Leave false to read signals found by earlier scans.

since_days.description: Only posts from the last N days, 1-365.

status.description: Only signals in this state. Omit for all states.

web_mode.description: Only used with scan: true. "single" queries one web-search provider; "parallel" queries every configured provider and merges the results, for wider coverage at more upstream cost.

name: find_intent_signals
title: Find intent signals
